§6Antimatter§f

§aMatter's opposite. Touch normal matter and both disappear. Store it wrong and your base goes with them.§f

§bAntimatter§f is a gas held in cells or capsules. It is the gateway to antischrabidium, flashgold, and the deepest end-game content. Standard barrels explode on contact. Use §bMagnetic Antimatter Containment Barrels§f.

§6Make It§f:
§b•§f Particle Accelerator (score §e300§f): H Ion Capsule + Cu Ion Capsule -> Antiproton + Positron
§b•§f Crafting Table (shapeless): Antiproton + Positron + Empty Cell -> §eAntimatter Cell§f
§b•§f Cyclotron byproduct, small amounts from most recipes
§b•§f Spaceship loot

§6What It Is For§f:
§b•§f §bAntischrabidium§f, 2x antimatter capsules in accelerator (score 400)
§b•§f §bMuon Capsule§f, antimatter + H ion (score 2,500)
§b•§f §bFlashgold§f, antimatter + Au-198 + ionized particles
§b•§f §bFlashlead§f, flashgold + Pb-209 + antimatter
§b•§f §bAntimatter Cluster§f, 9 cells in a full grid
§b•§f §bCustom Nuke Rod§f, antimatter cell + copper + aluminium plates

§ePS:§f One antimatter capsule needs two particle accelerator runs (H ion + Cu ion). Budget your accelerator time accordingly.
